name: Lashi

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Lashi (lash1243).

notes: Skeleton. Lashi (Leqi) is a Burmish (Sino-Tibetan) language of Myanmar and Yunnan, written here in a Latin-based transcription. Base Latin consonants and vowels plus digraphs ch/sh/ts/ng/ny, aspirates kh/ph/th and the voiceless lateral hl are mapped. Lexical tone is not recovered by the romanization and is left unencoded, so an elevated PER floor is expected. Lashi is tonal; tone is not orthographically marked in the Latin-based transcription and is left unencoded, and stress is not separately contrastive (documented exemption).

sources.notes: Literature review consolidating published segmental-phonology descriptions of Lashi (Lacid) across sources (Luce 1985, Huang et al. 1992, Wannemacher 1995-7 as cited in Mann 1998, Yabu 1988); no dedicated reference grammar of Lashi exists, so this review is the closest available primary synthesis and was checked against the consonant/digraph inventory modelled here.
